mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact frozen clock current, regular analytic quartic reduction, critical cube-root balance and exceptional branches of the unchanged canonical W, with independent bounded root and envelope controls
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Symbolic rational functions and real square roots in SymPy; exact rational polynomial root isolation; mpmath at 60 and 90 decimal digits
mathematics.conventions: Signature -+++; tau=t+sigma(r), chi=q*t+pi(r), z=sigma_prime, p=pi_prime, |z|<1; zero stationary radial clock charge; Delta=U-2*d*q^2>0; F=-one_half*dL_reduced/dp
inputs: Canonical W=Wc+2*d*ell*(sqrt(1+Y/ell)-1), Wc=U+lambda_W with lambda_W=-2*gamma*qbar^2*qbar_dot; canonical P with lambda_X=3*gamma*qbar*Hbar

bounds.symbolic_orders: Regular action through p^4, tilt through p^3; critical weighted action through order six with p=t^3 and z=O(t), tilt through t^3
bounds.root_isolation: Exact rational intervals width at most 10^-70; numerical unsquared residual below 10^-45; direct root agreement below 10^-44

non_claims: No full on-shell metric/clock/scalar PDE or boundary matching theorem
No identification of p with the physical lapse force
No claim that numerical parameter controls are available fixed-history cosmological solutions
No all-branch theorem outside the timelike, positive-log, frozen, zero-clock-current reduction
No numerical fit, new matter coupling, changed W, or MOND acceleration scale
